name: Light box
blurb: Pictures, text and shapes that glow in a framed box. LED strips glue in through the back cover.

name: Keychain
blurb: A picture or a name traced into a flat, multi-colour tag with a ring hole.

name: Sign
blurb: Raised lettering on a plate: door signs, name plates, shelf labels and badges.

name: Lithophane
blurb: Your photo as a thin plate that shows the picture when a light shines through it.

name: License plate
blurb: A custom plate frame or a novelty plate with your own words, font and colours.

name: Nameplate
blurb: Layered nameplates from a subject and a style, or a blank plate with your own picture.

name: Hype chain
blurb: A chunky pendant from a logo or your own text, with a printed chain to match.
